trace.notes: Normalized the single input as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with trailing identifier 5309792. Local shard metadata and exact-title search metadata identify the exact work as Elijah Liflyand, "Open Problems on Hausdorff Operators", in Complex Analysis and Potential Theory, pages 280-285, 2007, DOI 10.1142/9789812778833_0030, MR 2368363, Zbl 1156.30002.

failure_mode=blocked_or_challenged. Direct local fetching of https://zbmath.org/5309792 and the zbMATH API failed in the sandbox because outbound DNS could not resolve zbMATH hosts. The browser/page reader did not expose a readable zbMATH record body for the exact URL.

failure_mode=metadata_only. The Bar-Ilan University CRIS page and exact DOI/citation references confirmed the title, author, year, book title, and page range, but exposed only bibliographic metadata and no full technical problem statements. The World Scientific DOI/PDF endpoints could not be opened as readable artifacts in the available browser context.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched by the exact title, exact title plus PDF, DOI 10.1142/9789812778833_0030, ISBN 9789812778833, and zbMATH identifier 5309792. Candidate pages inspected or surfaced included Bar-Ilan CRIS, World Scientific DOI endpoints, Google Books, library catalog metadata, DML/Cambridge/ScienceDirect citing pages, and Scribd previews. These were rejected because they were metadata-only, citation/reference pages, blocked/cache-miss endpoints, no-preview book pages, related works rather than the requested work, or non-source-authorized/malformed previews that did not provide a reliable readable full-text artifact for the exact source.

No candidate question was accepted because the workflow forbids extracting technical questions from abstracts, bibliographic metadata, search snippets, citation-only pages, related papers, or unreadable/non-source-authorized previews when the complete problem statements are not visible in a chosen primary source artifact.
Saved exact JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/5309792.json and outputs/latest.json.
